name: @story/multi-engine-server
comment:scripts: No build step and no `dist/` (REFACTOR_PLAN §7): the internal packages are consumed as TypeScript source, so the server runs them through `tsx`, which is a root devDependency.
comment:dependencies: Only what `src/index.ts` actually imports today. `@story/core` for `buildWorldState` and `@story/data` for the story register — the scaffold really does build this story's `TWorldState` at boot, which is the one piece of §3's "server owns TWorldState" that exists so far. Everything HTTP comes from `node:http`; there is deliberately no `ws` dependency (see the note in `src/index.ts`).
